description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the 'updater' component of the 'thingsearch' service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides method signatures for retrieving various configuration parameters such as max idle time, bulk size, polling intervals, activation status, and background sync configuration. It also includes an enum of known configuration keys with default values.

classes.name: UpdaterConfig.UpdaterConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration representing known configuration path expressions and their default values for the UpdaterConfig.

methods.name: getMaxIdleTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum idle time for an idling ThingUpdater.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of write operations performed in one bulk.

methods.name: getShardingStatePollInterval
methods.description: Returns how frequently the sharding state is polled and how often the cluster state is checked.

methods.name: isEventProcessingActive
methods.description: Indicates whether event processing should be active.

methods.name: getBackgroundSyncConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the background synchronization actor.
